text:
jess: Heads-up: onboarding sample app is producing duplicate webhook side-effects when the client hits a 401, does a token refresh, then receives a 429 during retry. Repro in prod-sim with low traffic.
omar: Ugh. Which SDKs are you seeing this in?
jess: Node and Python. Node seems to replay the whole POST after refresh+429. Python only replays if idempotency-key present.
kelly: Can you paste the request/response headers? We should be enforcing idempotency-key for anything that mutates state.
jess: Logs (sanitized):
```
deploy-bot: token-refresh start for client-id abc123
http 401 -> trigger refresh -> refresh ok -> retry original POST -> http 429 -> SDK retries immediately -> duplicate webhook delivered
```
matt: Sounds like a race between auth refresh and the retry/backoff logic. Node's transport retry is firing before the app-layer marks the request idempotent.
omar: Proposal to achieve parity: 1) SDKs should not auto-replay non-idempotent requests across an auth refresh unless idempotency-key is present. 2) Provide a `safeReplay` opt-in config (default false) so integrators can enable it knowingly. 3) Use full jitter exponential backoff on 429s.
kelly: I like that. Also update the sample app to demonstrate the token-rotate hook pattern that queues in-flight mutating requests until refresh finishes, or adds idempotency-key for retries. That will reduce onboarding friction.
jess: I can prep a PR for the sample app. Quick ask: what jitter/backoff params are we recommending for short RPCs (~50-300ms p50)?
matt: We generally use base=50ms, factor=2, cap=2000ms, full jitter (sleep = random(0, min(cap, base*2^attempt))). For aggressive 429s we add a small randomized linear increment to avoid synchronized retries.
omar: Also note: for streaming responses we use different heuristics (small linear backoff + tiny jitter) to avoid long stall + resume semantics. We'll document that separately.
kelly: Can we also add a lint rule in sample app CI to ensure POSTs to side-effect endpoints either include idempotency-key or opt-out annotated? That will help new integrators.
ci-bot: New lint job `dx-idempotency-check` added to sample-app pipeline.
deploy-bot: Alert rule created: `duplicate-webhook-rate > 0.5% over 5m` -> Pager/Triage ticket created (#1234).
jess: :thumbsup: I'll open two PRs: sample-app patch + short SDK parity RFC.
matt: Assign reviewers @omar @kelly. Keep the RFC focused: auth-refresh + 429 interaction, safeReplay opt-in, recommended jitter params, sample app snippet.
omar: I'll draft the SDK change list (node + python + go parity points).
kelly: Thanks — once PRs are up, we can add a short blurb to the onboarding checklist so new users don't hit this same trap.
